name: druidforms
description: Shared design system (components, styles, theming) for Lit apps — the browser half of the druidforms package
author: bitdruid

scripts.build: npm run build:vendor && npm run build:standalone && npm run build:npm && npm run types && npm run contracts
scripts.build:vendor: esbuild web/src/lit-vendor.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --banner:js='/* lit-vendor.js - GENERATED third-party chunk: the Lit runtime (see package.json for the pinned version). Do not edit. */' --outfile=druids/static/lit-vendor.js
scripts.build:standalone: esbuild web/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --external:*lit-vendor.js --loader:.svg=text --banner:js='/* druids.js - GENERATED bundle of the druids components. Do not edit; run `npm run build` in the framework repo. Imports the Lit runtime from ./lit-vendor.js */' --outfile=druids/static/druids.js
scripts.build:npm: esbuild web/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --external:lit --external:lit/* --loader:.svg=text --banner:js='/* druidforms - GENERATED npm entry point. Do not edit; run `npm run build` in the framework repo. Lit stays external, so it dedupes with the consuming app. */' --outfile=dist/druids.js
